problem.textKh: បញ្ជាក់ L: y=-x ជាអាស៊ីម​តូតទ្រេត ហើយស្វែងរកទីតាំងសម្ពាន្ធ (C) និង L
problem.text: Prove L: y=-x is oblique asymptote and find relative position of curve C and line L

solutionSteps.textKh: បញ្ជាក់ L ជាអាស៊ីម​តូតទ្រេត
ដូចនេះ L: y=-x ជាអាស៊ីម​តូត
solutionSteps.explanation: Since f(x)-(-x) → 0 as x→+∞, L is an oblique asymptote

solutionSteps.textKh: ទីតាំងសម្ពាន្ធ: y_C - y_L = -4ln(x)/x
ប្រៀបធៀបសញ្ញា

solutionSteps.text: For x∈(0,1): lnx<0 so -4lnx/x > 0, C is above L

solutionSteps.textKh: ពេល x∈(1,+∞): ln(x)>0 → y_C-y_L < 0 → C នៅក្រោម L
solutionSteps.text: For x∈(1,+∞): lnx>0 so -4lnx/x < 0, C is below L

finalAnswer.textKh: L: y=-x ជាអាស៊ីម​តូតទ្រេត | (C) ប្រសព្វ L នៅ x=1 | x∈(0,1): C នៅលើ L | x∈(1,+∞): C នៅក្រោម L
finalAnswer.text: L: y=-x is oblique asymptote. C meets L at x=1. C is above L for x∈(0,1) and below L for x∈(1,+∞).

chunks.text: បង្ហាញ f'(x) < 0 ៖ x>0 ។ រកតង់ហ្សង់ D ស្របជាមួយ L: y=-x
chunks.normalizedText: For f(x) = -x - 4ln(x)/x, show f'(x) < 0 for all x>0 by computing f'(x) = -(x²+4-4ln(x))/x² and showing x²+4-4ln(x)>0. Find tangent D parallel to L (slope -1): tangent point A(e, -e-4/e), tangent line y = -x - 4/e.

problem.textKh: បង្ហាញ f'(x) < 0 ∀x>0 ហើយរក D ស្របជាមួយ L
problem.text: Show f'(x) < 0 for all x>0. Find tangent parallel to L: y=-x.

solutionSteps.textKh: គណនា f'(x)
solutionSteps.latex: f'(x) = -1 - \frac{(4\ln x)'\cdot x - 4\ln x \cdot 1}{x^2} = -1 - \frac{\frac{4}{x}\cdot x - 4\ln x}{x^2} = -1 - \frac{4-4\ln x}{x^2}

solutionSteps.textKh: សំព្រួញ f'(x)
បង្ហាញ x²+4-4ln(x)>0 ∀x>0
តង់ហ្សង់ D ស្របជាមួយ L → f'(x₀)=-1
solutionSteps.text: Tangent parallel to L means f'(x₀)=-1
solutionSteps.latex: -\frac{x_A^2+4-4\ln x_A}{x_A^2} = -1 \implies x_A^2+4-4\ln x_A = x_A^2 \implies 4\ln x_A = 4 \implies x_A = e

solutionSteps.textKh: y_A = f(e)
សមីការ D

finalAnswer.text: f'(x) < 0 for all x>0 (f is strictly decreasing). Tangency point A(e, -e-4/e). Tangent D: y = -x - 4/e.

chunks.text: S(a) = ផ្ទៃដែលរឹតព័ត្ចន ដោយ (C) និង L នៅចន្លោះ 1 ≤ x ≤ a ។ រក a ដើម្បី S(a) = 2
chunks.normalizedText: S(a) is the area between curve C and line L for 1 ≤ x ≤ a, where f(x) = -x - 4ln(x)/x and L: y=-x. Compute S(a) = ∫₁ᵃ (4lnx/x) dx = 2ln²a. Set S(a)=2: 2ln²a=2 → lna=±1 → a=e (since a>1).

problem.textKh: S(a) ជាផ្ទៃដែលរឹតព័ត ដោយ (C) និង L នៅ 1≤x≤a ។ រក a ដើម្បី S(a)=2
problem.text: S(a) is the area enclosed by C and L for 1≤x≤a. Find a such that S(a)=2.

solutionSteps.textKh: ផ្ទៃ S(a): C នៅក្រោម L ពេល x>1 ដូចនេះ
solutionSteps.text: For x>1, C is below L, so |f(x)-(-x)| = 4lnx/x

solutionSteps.textKh: ប្រើ (ln x)' = 1/x ដើម្បីធ្វើ substitution
solutionSteps.latex: \int \frac{4\ln x}{x}\ dx = \int 4\ln x \cdot (\ln x)'\ dx = \left[\frac{4\ln^2 x}{2}\right] = 2\ln^2 x

solutionSteps.textKh: គណនា S(a)
ដោះស្រាយ S(a)=2
ជ្រើស a>1: a = e⁻¹ = 1/e < 1 → ច្រានចោល | a = e > 1 → ទទួលយក
solutionSteps.text: Since a>1: a=1/e<1 is rejected, a=e is accepted
